title: Docs use "self-managed" not "self-hosted" for Grafana
answers: Should Grafana docs say self-hosted or self-managed?
Terminology standard for on-prem Grafana in docs
body:
Grafana docs terminology has moved from "self-hosted" to "self-managed" when referring to non-cloud Grafana deployments (e.g. Terraform provider comment "For self-managed Grafana" in docs/sources/datasources/azure-monitor/configure/index.md).
Apply this substitution when editing or reviewing any docs page still using "self-hosted", including in code comments inside doc examples.
Constraints: only applies where the older release branch's content doesn't otherwise diverge — when backporting, only make this wording swap on content that already exists in that branch, don't introduce unrelated newer sections along with it.
applies: Any Grafana documentation referring to non-cloud/on-prem Grafana instances
